class.name: FoliageLayer
class.brief_description: A single paintable vegetation type inside a [FoliagePainter3D].
class.description: [FoliageLayer] describes one kind of vegetation that a [FoliagePainter3D]'s brush can paint: how much random scale/rotation/normal deviation to apply to each instance, how densely and how far apart the brush places them, and - through [member lod_levels] - which mesh(es) to actually render at which distance. This resource is pure configuration; it does not store any instance data itself. [FoliagePainter3D] paints and stores this layer's instances, spatially chunked into a grid of cells (see [member FoliagePainter3D.cell_size]) so that off-screen cells can be culled by the renderer independently. Use [FoliagePainter3D]'s brush tool, or its [method FoliagePainter3D.insert_instance] / [method FoliagePainter3D.remove_instance] / [method FoliagePainter3D.add_instance] methods, to add or remove instances.

method.name: has_any_mesh
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one entry in [member lod_levels] has a [member FoliageLODLevel.mesh] assigned, i.e. this layer actually renders something. The brush refuses to paint a layer for which this returns [code]false[/code].

members.member: Blends each instance's up axis between world up ([code]0.0[/code]) and the surface normal at the paint location ([code]1.0[/code]). Combined with [member random_tilt_degrees], this controls how much instances deviate from the surface normal.

If [code]false[/code], this layer's instances do not cast shadows (equivalent to setting [member GeometryInstance3D.cast_shadow] to [constant GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF] on every LOD level's internal [MultiMeshInstance3D]). Shared by every entry in [member lod_levels]; there is no per-LOD override.

The approximate number of instances the brush attempts to place per paint stamp while this layer is active. Actual placement is also limited by [member min_instance_spacing] and by whether a valid surface is found under each sample point.

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.gi_mode] for this layer's instances. Defaults to [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DISABLED]: grass and other small scattered foliage rarely benefit visually from baked or dynamic global illumination, and skipping it avoids [LightmapGI] trying to lightmap every scattered instance and avoids the per-instance cost of looking up nearby GI probes. Set to [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_STATIC] or [constant GeometryInstance3D.GI_MODE_DYNAMIC] per layer (e.g. for larger foliage like bushes or trees) where the difference is worth it.

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.ignore_screen_space_shadows] for this layer's instances. Enable this to exclude dense, small foliage (e.g. grass) from screen-space contact shadows, which can otherwise be a relatively expensive effect to compute over thousands of small instances for little visual benefit. Shared by every entry in [member lod_levels].

The number of instances currently painted for this layer, summed across all of [FoliagePainter3D]'s cells. This is read-only and for informational display in the Inspector only; it is kept up to date automatically and is not saved with this resource.
A display name for this layer, shown in [FoliagePainter3D]'s brush layer list and used to name its internal [MultiMeshInstance3D] nodes.

Equivalent to [member GeometryInstance3D.lod_bias] for this layer's instances: values above [code]1.0[/code] make each LOD level's own mesh-internal LODs (if any) switch to a lower level of detail sooner, values below [code]1.0[/code] delay switching. This is unrelated to - and stacks with - the level selection done via [member lod_levels]' own visibility ranges. Shared by every entry in [member lod_levels].

The chain of [FoliageLODLevel]s (e.g. LOD_0, LOD_1, LOD_2) this layer renders through, in order from highest to lowest detail. Every level shares the exact same painted instance transforms; only its mesh, material, and visibility/fade distance range differ (see [FoliageLODLevel]). A newly created [FoliageLayer] starts with three levels with reasonable default distances, but this array can hold any number of levels, including just one (no LOD switching) or zero (nothing renders; see [method has_any_mesh]).
The upper bound of the random uniform scale applied to each painted instance. See also [member min_scale].
The minimum distance the brush enforces between two instances of this layer. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to allow instances to be placed arbitrarily close together.
The lower bound of the random uniform scale applied to each painted instance. See also [member max_scale].
If [code]true[/code], each painted instance receives a random rotation around its up axis.
The maximum random tilt, in degrees, applied on top of [member align_to_normal_amount] for natural-looking variation from instance to instance.
